review_description: Solahart East Gippsland had a professional sales rep who listened to our needs and provided a considered opinion. The price was not the cheapest we received,but to our mind the best for warranty, system, installation and after sales service…..

The whole process went very well. Solahart were quick to contact us and make an appointment to assess our needs. The sales team and installation team were all friendly and helpful. Very responsive to our queries, great customer service, and we are delighted with the result.
